clips.title: The story
paras: Raene Wolfrunner is an accomplished Sentinel officer and hunter stationed at the heart of Astranaar in Ashenvale. Accompanied by her loyal wolf and saber cat companions, she coordinates defense efforts across the forest against encroaching Horde forces and corrupted furbolg tribes. She serves as a vital anchor for Alliance champions striving to protect the sacred wilderness.

Raene Wolfrunner stands watchful in Astranaar alongside her trusty saber cat Korra and wolf Dagri. As an officer among the Sentinels, she oversees patrols throughout Ashenvale and coordinates intelligence reaching beyond its borders, dispatching scouts like Kaela Shadowspear into neighboring regions such as the Stonetalon Mountains.

Beyond the tensions with the Horde, Raene is deeply invested in addressing the dark taint sickening Ashenvale's native denizens. She directs campaigns against hostile furbolg tribes, including aggressive strikes against the Foulweald camps harassing travelers and targeted culls against rising Thistlefur leadership. Her subordinate scouts keep close watch over changing furbolg behavior, relying on Raene's steady command to protect local settlements and passing wayfarers from coordinated ambushes.
